name: Julien Sanchez - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the EU budget was protected from fraud in 2024. It is an opinion, not a law, so nothing changes directly. It asks the European Commission to improve how it reports on fraud and recovery of money, to give anti-fraud bodies better access to tax and customs data, to make funding for member states' projects more transparent, and to tighten safeguards for money spent through the Recovery and Resilience Facility and for support to Ukraine.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks the Commission to act on fraud reporting, data access and transparency.
- **Who it affects:** The Commission, anti-fraud bodies, member states managing EU funds, and fund recipients.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to follow the requests; Parliament votes on the report in plenary.
